topPRs.title: validation: remove legacy kona prestates from standard list
topPRs.author: claude
topPRs.body:
<!-- ccr-slack-attribution -->
_Requested by **Adrian Sutton** · [Slack thread](https://oplabs-pbc.slack.com/archives/C07LZR2JM88/p1785275474188729?thread_ts=1785275474.188729&cid=C07LZR2JM88)_

Removes the six legacy kona versions (1.1.6, 1.1.7, 1.2.2, 1.2.4, 1.2.5, 1.2.7) from the standard prestates list — none were ever a real release and no chain uses them.

Companion to an optimism PR that stops rebuilding these prestates in the reproducibility job. The two must merge together, or the scheduled job's reverse-check fails on entries that are still expected but no longer built.
